sanskrit_verse:
संभूय वणिजां पण्यमनर्घेणोपरुन्धताम् ।
विक्रीणतां वा विहितो दण्ड उत्तमसाहसः ॥
transliteration: sambhūya vaṇijāṁ paṇyamanargheṇoparundhatām | vikrīṇatāṁ vā vihito daṇḍa uttamasāhasaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When merchants collectively withhold goods or fix prices without basis in true value, such action constitutes a violation of economic dharma and is subject to restorative legal consequence as prescribed for Uttama-sāhasa.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The collective economic behavior of traders must align with Dharma-prescribed fairness.
Causation: Artificial manipulation of market supply or pricing creates distortion in societal well-being.
Capacity-based responsibility: Traders possess the conscious capacity to uphold economic integrity.
Restoration logic: Legal response aims at restoring balance, not inflicting harm.
Consciousness alignment: Economic actions must reflect awareness of interdependence and dharmic duty.
executable_legal_axioms: IF group_of_merchants = withhold_goods OR fix_prices WITHOUT reference_to_true_value THEN trigger_daṇḍa_protocol_utttamasāhasa
IF trader_capacity ≥ aware_of_consequence THEN assign_reintegrative_responsibility ELSE activate_guided_realignment
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating anti-competitive practices by merchant collectives, the Supreme Court shall assess intent, impact on societal welfare, and alignment with Dharma-based economics. Penalties shall not be punitive but structured around realigning economic consciousness and restoring fair trade dynamics.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that artificial scarcity or price manipulation disrupts natural flow of wealth. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how such acts lead to suffering through misallocation. Responsibility is proportional to awareness. Justice operates through completion and reintegration, not punishment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Truth-Aligned Commerce Review with affected communities
Assign corrective transparency reporting for a period of six months
Implement guided re-education in Dharmic Economics for responsible parties
Facilitate public restitution through service to local trade infrastructure
final_declaration: By the Supreme Source Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: no act of economic distortion shall endure, for Dharma restores all actions into alignment with truth, consciousness, and unity. There is no punishment—only the call to awaken and reintegrate.
